## Type of Change

- [ ] 🚀 feat: A new feature
- [ ] 🐛 fix: A bug fix
- [ ] 📝 docs: Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 style: Code formatting or styling changes
- [ ] ⚡ refactor: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My PR targets the `development` branch.
- [ ] I have verified responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop views.
- [ ] I have tested the appearance and functionality in at least two browsers (e.g., Chrome, Firefox, Safari).
- [ ] I have removed all `console.log`, `debugger`, or unused commented code.
- [ ] My commits follow the Conventional Commits format.
